nodes.label: reconstructAll Queue Processor
nodes.rationale: Processes queue sequentially with exponential back-off + jitter (up to 5 retries) on 429/503/504 so a busy/cold backend does not drop uploads.

nodes.label: GAN Audio Super-Resolution
nodes.rationale: Generator learns a residual (output = generator(input) + input), predicting the difference between lossy and lossless rather than the full waveform.

nodes.label: Setup Download Retry Logic (v1.1.0)
nodes.rationale: Retries transient failures (resets, timeouts, 5xx) with linear backoff but fails fast on 4xx, so a flaky connection no longer forces restarting setup.

nodes.label: git-lfs Model Distribution
nodes.rationale: model.onnx is committed to the repo via git-lfs rather than hosted on HuggingFace, so cloning the repo is enough to get the shipped model.

nodes.label: Torch-free ONNX Inference (inference.py)
nodes.rationale: Runs the model with onnxruntime only (CPU wheel ~15-30MB vs PyTorch ~200MB+) so the enhancer can ship as a small download-and-run package for users without Python.

nodes.label: Fixed Input Shape (1,2,131072)
nodes.rationale: The model is only ever called on 131072-sample (~2.97s) chunks; chunking happens outside forward(), so no dynamic axes are needed.
